failure_summary.description: Responses substituted a related fact or description for the entity or attribute requested by the clue.
Answers used a more specific form than requested or expanded a title beyond the expected short form.
The fill-in instruction led the agent to omit an integral part of a conventional multiword label.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers identifying the requested relation and matching answer specificity, so adding more rules on those points would duplicate existing guidance. The fill-in instruction needs a narrow exception for fixed multiword labels, where returning only the blank can omit part of the requested entity name.

edits.target: For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component; do not repeat information already given in the clue or add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer.
edits.content: For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component when that is the requested answer. If the blank is embedded in a fixed multiword label and the requested referent is the label as a whole, return its complete conventional form rather than mechanically omitting the part already shown. Do not add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer.
